Quick HSK 1 quiz 🎬

电影 (diànyǐng) is made of 电 = electricity and 影 = shadow. So what is an "electric shadow"?

A) a lamp
B) a movie
C) a TV

Comment A, B or C 👇 Then tell us: what's the last Chinese movie you watched?
